biggest_catch: Typical fee is only $5-10 per shop (BestMark itself states $7-20), with many shops mostly reimbursement — and you float upfront costs until paid.
catches: Fees per BestMark's stated $7-20 range; reimbursement listed separately and is not income.
Report deadlines are strict — late filing can jeopardize payment.
Some shops require upfront purchase/service costs reimbursed later.
Shop availability varies heavily by location; not steady work.

c2.evidence: Official FAQ: 'Payments are made between the 15th and 20th of each month for successfully completed and approved shops from the previous calendar month.' Company states pay generally $7-$20 per job.

c3.evidence: Official FAQ confirms payment may be 'a reimbursement for a meal or purchase and/or a cash payment' — fees separated from reimbursement.

c4.evidence: Signup is free via website application; no fee charged to shoppers.

steps: Browse available assignments in your area
Self-assign or request assignment for shops you want
Complete the shop per detailed instructions
File the online report (deadlines strict, e.g. by 10am Central next day)
Get paid 15th-20th of the following month
timing: Payments made between the 15th and 20th of each month for approved shops from the previous calendar month (3-4 weeks after completion). PayPal, direct deposit, or gift card.
maximize: Only claim shops where the cash fee beats your gas and report time — every listing shows the fee and reimbursement before you accept, so never take a losing shop. File the report the same day; late reports risk non-payment. Stack BestMark with the other verified MSPs in this lane so you get first pick of shops near you.
